Data: docs/results/store.json, 2026-10-22. Host: AMD Ryzen 7 9700X, 16 threads, 8g per server.
PostgreSQL 18.6, pg_sift 3.3, Elasticsearch 9.5.5, ClickHouse 26.9.19.9, Citus 14.2-1. 3 CPUs per server, 1,000,000 orders. Cold: caches
